# Third-party data used for evaluation/training

* `pif_injections.json`, `pif_benign.json` - benchmark samples from Prompt-Injection-Firewall
  (https://github.com/ogulcanaydogan/Prompt-Injection-Firewall), Apache License 2.0. Used to train and evaluate the
  prompt-injection text classifier (`codeguard/ml/train_text.py`). Unmodified copies.
